name: io.github.theprodsde/agent-memory
description: Persistent agent memory with a decision layer: replay, restore, verify, or none — explainable.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEMORY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the persistent memory store (default: ~/.agent_memory)

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEMORY_COLLECTION
environmentVariables.description: Collection (database) name within the memory directory
